title: LegislationObject
description: One file of a piece of legislation - the actual document, not the law itself.

@type.description: Always `LegislationObject`. Dual-typed as `Legislation` and `MediaObject` - the FRBR work/expression split that ELI and Akoma Ntoso both rely on: the `Legislation` is the law, a `LegislationObject` is a particular rendering of it.

encodingFormat.description: The file's IANA media type. Use `application/akn+xml` for Akoma Ntoso.

legislationLegalValue.description: Which of several parallel renderings of the same law is authoritative. The same law may have an authoritative signed PDF, an Akoma Ntoso XML marked up for machines, and an unofficial HTML reading copy - this is what says which is which, so consumers can pick the citable text rather than guessing from the file extension. Real schema.org `LegalValueLevel` enumeration.

dateModified.description: When this specific file was last modified.

conformsTo.description: The document standard this file follows, e.g. the Akoma Ntoso namespace URI.
